description: This file defines the MoneyTransaction class representing financial transactions and the TxType enum to distinguish between income and expense transactions. It also includes a method for returning a signed amount and a method for determining color representation based on transaction type.

classes.name: MoneyTransaction
classes.description: Represents a financial transaction with properties like id, amount, type, category, date, and optional note. Provides methods for getting signed amount and color based on transaction type.

methods.name: signedAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount with a sign indicating income or expense.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Returns a theme-based color indicating whether the transaction is income or expense.
